strategy.overview: The upper drop targets light Extra Ball collections, the lower targets light side Special, and clearing both three-target banks lights Special at the center basketball target. Clear all six targets to light Special at the center basketball target. The upper-left lanes collect a lit bonus, multiplier, or Extra Ball.
strategy.simpleOverview: The upper drop targets light Extra Ball collections, the lower targets light side Special, and clearing both three-target banks lights Special at the center basketball target. Use the upper-left lanes when a bonus, multiplier, or Extra Ball is lit there.
strategy.summary: Attack both three-bank drop-target sets: upper target pairs light Extra Ball collections, lower pairs light Special, and clearing both complete banks lights Special at the center basketball target. The upper-left lanes collect the lit bonus ladder, multiplier, or Extra Ball.

quickInfo.name: Extra Ball
quickInfo.summary: Knock down the upper two targets on a side, then use that side's lit collection shot.

quickInfo.name: Side Special
quickInfo.summary: Knock down the lower two targets on a side, then use the lit side basketball target or top lane.

quickInfo.name: Center Special
quickInfo.summary: Clear both complete three-target banks, then hit the center basketball target.

quickInfo.name: Upper-left lanes
quickInfo.summary: Collect the displayed bonus with its lit 2x or 5x multiplier, or collect a lit Extra Ball.

steps.text: Work one three-target bank with controlled shots; the upper two targets light that side's Extra Ball collections.
Use the lit collection at the top lanes, the standup behind that bank, or that side's outlane rather than assuming the award is automatic.
Knock down the lower two targets on a side to light Special at the corresponding side basketball standup and top rollover.
Clear all six drop targets across both banks to light Special at the center basketball target.
Watch the points ladder beside the upper-left lanes and take a lane only when its bonus or multiplier is lit.
After clearing the left bank for Extra Ball, use the upper-left lane carrying the lit Extra Ball award.
Keep the ball alive around the widely spaced pop bumpers; the lower two score directly and the top bumper adds to bonus.

machineSetup: Confirm this is Marsa Play's 2010 New Canasta remake, not Inder's 1986 Canasta or Quetzal's unrelated Super Canasta design.
Check all six magnetic drop-target sensors, the side and center basketball standups, the four top lanes, the upper-left lanes, and outlane award sensors.

cautions.issue: Three similarly named canasta-themed machines have different rule sets.
cautions.response: Use this drop-bank and award-light route only for Marsa Play's 2010 New Canasta; do not transfer rules from Canasta '86 or Super Canasta.
